newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Transcrypt started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Transcrypt started as buy.

text.p: --Dain Bosworth Inc said Tuesday it initiated coverage of Transcrypt International Inc as a buy.

--It expects revenue growth for the provider of information security for land mobile radio products to accelerate with the introduction of several new products. In a report, Dain Bosworth said it believes Transcrypt can grow earnings "in the 50 percent range for the next three to five years."
--Its earnings per share estimates on the company are $0.56 for 1997 and $0.90 for 1998.
